entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF88-12-C4.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF88-12-C4. I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. That was 38 days ago.
I just need to understand the situation a bit better. To start, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?
It works. I just couldn't deal with it. I had a medical emergency.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright now. Can you tell me what happened? We sometimes have exceptions for situations like that.
I was in the hospital. I had to have emergency surgery. So, no, I didn't get a chance to open your box on time. My priorities were elsewhere.

Of course. I completely understand, and I apologize if my question came off as insensitive. Thank you for sharing that. I just need to check the return authorization policy for these circumstances. Please hold one moment.

Okay, thank you for your patience... Actually, I have some good news. It looks like there's no need to process a special exception. Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor is covered under our standard 10-day return policy.
You're telling me I just explained my private medical situation for no reason.

My apologies for the confusion, I was just making sure we covered all the bases for you. Since you're unfortunately outside the 10 days, I've gone ahead and approved the return. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. You'll receive a full refund once our warehouse processes it.
Yes, it is. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I sincerely hope your recovery is a smooth one.
